name: thinking-orb
title: thinking-orb
description: A procedural thinking orb — a scan meridian sweeping a dotted globe, the assistant's "I'm on it" presence.

definition.name: thinking-orb
definition.description: A procedural thinking orb — a scan meridian sweeping a dotted globe, the assistant's "I'm on it" presence.
definition.whenToUse: The thinking indicator for an AI surface — a procedural orb animation on its own, no chrome and no words. Set orbState to match the activity. For the same animation behind an assistant's face use avatar-orb; for three-dot typing feedback keep the wave dots.

orbState.description: What the assistant is doing: working, waiting, done. Decides how the orb moves.

speed.description: How fast the animation runs. 1 is normal.

orbColor.description: The orb's colour, as a token name.
